title: Robotic Surgery Jumped 98% In Four Years
hook: Robotic surgery nearly doubled in four years.
closing: Robots are moving from operating-room novelty to routine care patients will encounter.
question: Would you trust robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic procedures rose 98%, turning a specialized tool into mainstream surgery.
Robots handled 15.1% of general surgeries, showing they were no longer rare.
Robotic-surgery revenue reached $7.1 billion, reflecting how quickly hospitals adopted the technology.
